headline: Brent Crude Rises to $92.88 Amid Middle East Tensions and Oversupply Forecasts
summary: Brent crude rose 1.1% to $92.88 per barrel as forecasts of a coming oil surplus collided with continued Middle East attacks and stalled diplomacy, keeping prices in a narrow range.
why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for international petroleum pricing.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent crude futures rose 1.1% to $92.88 per barrel.
